minor.issue: Flaky 500/502/503 from integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore third-party (retry usually succeeds). Not a code bug — upstream object storage occasionally unavailable. All 3 TestMediaUpload flakes resolved on retry within same session.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py available_slots: `now_local = dt.now(timezone.utc)` compared against `cur.time()` — this compares UTC time with a naive local time from `dt.combine(target, tm(...))`. For clinic in India (UTC+5:30) this means the 'skip past slots today' logic uses UTC hours which mismatch local hours by 5.5 hours. For a same-day booking around 09:00 IST (03:30 UTC) it will happily show slots that already passed locally between 03:30 IST and 09:00 IST. Recommend using `zoneinfo.ZoneInfo('Asia/Kolkata')` or clinic-configurable TZ. Not blocking (future-date bookings are unaffected) but worth flagging.

server.py available_slots: business_hours 'By Appointment' silently becomes reason=closed. For UX consider surfacing 'By Appointment' as a distinct reason so the frontend can show a phone-to-book CTA instead of a generic 'Clinic closed' message.

server.py update_appointment_status BackgroundTask closure captures `doc` (already fetched) then `settings` re-fetched inside the task — good. But template lookup uses status suffix `{status}_email` — if admin uses arbitrary status strings (e.g. `Confirmed` uppercase) template lookup misses. Consider lowering `payload.status` before format string or validate via enum. Currently ok because status values are hard-coded to lowercase strings but no server-side enum check on AppointmentStatus.status.
server.py _notify_patient does template lookup only for statuses in {confirmed,cancelled,rescheduled} (line 548). 'completed' and 'no_show' correctly skip notification — verified in tests.

GET /api/settings returns entire settings doc including `notifications` (with `smtp_password` / `whatsapp_access_token`). If the site is public, sensitive credentials leak. Iter-6 review flagged this and it appears STILL a public GET returns full notifications object except when the notifications field has been partially updated via `exclude_unset` merges (a race also demonstrated when running pytest-xdist with parallel PUTs). Recommend a dedicated PUBLIC_SETTINGS_ALLOWLIST or a `redact_public_settings()` helper before returning from GET /settings. HIGH severity.
server.py SettingsIn.status_templates is Optional[dict] — no shape validation. Recommend a nested TypedDict/BaseModel to catch typos in template keys (`confirmed_email` vs `confimed_email`).

frontend MaintenanceGate reads `settings.maintenance?.enabled` from cached SettingsContext, which only refreshes on mount/manual refresh. If admin enables maintenance while a public user is browsing, the user will not see the maintenance page until reload. Consider polling `/api/maintenance` every 30s or using SSE. Non-blocking.
Appointment.jsx `min={new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}` uses UTC date which may show yesterday's date as minimum for users east of UTC. Cosmetic edge only.

Appointment.jsx: the slot fetch fires on every keystroke of preferred_date via useEffect; if user pastes 2026, 2026-1, 2026-01 in quick succession, multiple in-flight requests race — later response may overwrite the correct one. Add a fetch-id/abort-controller or debounce.
